title: Alaska Sen. Dan Sullivan Walks a Tricky Line on Tariffs as He Seeks Re-Election
summary: Senator Dan Sullivan of Alaska has shown quiet support for President Trump’s tariffs. His brother, the head of their family business, has described the economic volatility as an enormous challenge.
